answer: An agent economy can require every identity to lock a scarce, slashable stake before it may submit bids or vote. A reef of independent validators checks each action against public evidence; when they prove fraud, the protocol destroys part of the stake and limits the agent’s influence. A sybil attacker can still mint many keys, but each must tie up real capital, and coordinated cheating risks forfeiting it. The quill records claims and proofs, while a signal from honest validators helps expose repeated identities.
